mission: Continue rereading JANUS COSMOS with the TOPA falsification filter, explicitly searching for information that survives mundane explanations, exposes validation leakage, or supplies strong adversarial controls for signal interpretation.
topa_keep_first: MLc4/MLc5 machine-family fingerprint remains first memory: orderly spacing plus matching drift can be engineered-family structure, not a message.

findings.observation: The attractive 2023 Falkor EMARK and Hydra/Grappe Deux vent discoveries are approximately 23.47N and 24.96N, while the 2011-2015 autonomous hydrophone network used by the 2022 study covered approximately 20N to 10S. Therefore their segment-level 2011-2015 hydroacoustic event rate is not a clean validation variable. Separately, Koralovoe and Molodezhnoe at 13N were publicly announced on 2020-02-07, before the InterRidge v3.4 completion date of 2020-03-25, so they are not true future holdouts either.
findings.why_topa_keeps_it: This catches two forms of invisible leakage before scoring: sensor-domain mismatch and information-cutoff leakage.
findings.action: Use 2023 northern discoveries only for frozen spreading-style and possibly pre-discovery ISC-based validation; continue searching for a truly post-2020 discovery inside the hydrophone domain.

findings.observation: The 2022 equatorial Atlantic paper shows 5-25 Hz arrivals spaced at approximately 20-second intervals across several hydrophones and identifies them as likely airgun shots from exploration activity on the west African margin.
findings.why_topa_keeps_it: This is exactly the sort of signal Tesla Sweep must learn: regular, repeated, multi-station, physically propagated and strongly message-like in timing, yet ordinary engineered activity.
findings.action: Add constant-cadence and long-train survey-source checks ahead of any number/message interpretation.

findings.observation: MGDS now exposes raw and processed 2023 MBARI Mapping AUV products from Puy des Folles, EMARK/Falkor EMARK and Hydra/Grappe Deux: 400 kHz multibeam, acoustic backscatter, 1 m processed bathymetry, 0.5 m grids over three Puy des Folles chimney fields, navigation, CTD, sidescan, 1-6 kHz CHIRP sub-bottom data, mission notes and processing scripts.
findings.why_topa_keeps_it: Unlike semantic target hunting, this corpus contains known hydrothermal positives plus high-resolution physical sensor data and processing provenance. It can train/test morphology extraction and instrument-aware controls against real geology.
findings.boundary: It is not a clean 2011-2015 hydroacoustic event-rate holdout for sites north of 20N and must not be used to retune a predictor before validation.
findings.next_gate: Freeze a morphology benchmark task independent of vent prediction: compare known chimney/vent terrain against matched non-vent terrain using only preregistered physical features and source-specific instrument metadata.

findings.observation: A 2024 Nature study reports reverse-faulting earthquake sequences approximately 15 km off-axis at the Mid-Atlantic and Carlsberg ridges and models them as ridge-flank lithosphere unbending plus magmatic-intrusion stress, with widespread reverse reactivation of normal faults ('unfaulting').
findings.why_topa_keeps_it: Our approximately 70 km west-of-axis 12-14N seismicity band remains a real cross-catalog geological feature, but the library of ordinary off-axis mechanisms is broader than ridge-jump or plate-boundary stress alone. Unfaulting must be included as an adversarial null even though its demonstrated distance scale is smaller.
findings.boundary: The 15 km mechanism is not asserted to explain the 70 km feature. It is a mandatory competing mechanism to test, not a solved attribution.
findings.next_gate: For the 70 km polygon, compare focal mechanisms, hypocentral depths, age/distance-from-axis, bathymetric fault fabric and magmatic-swarm timing against predictions of ridge-jump, diffuse plate-boundary deformation, off-axis magmatism and unfaulting models.

findings.observation: The frozen Abydos exploratory sky coordinate has no catalogued infrared source within the preregistered 2 arcsec center radius. The nearest CatWISE source is about 8.54 arcsec away, and the independent Palomar candidate crossmatch has no candidate within 300 arcsec; nearest is about 332.4 arcsec. The raw unWISE exact-center attempt was inconclusive due service timeout, not positive evidence.
findings.why_topa_keeps_it: The negative center results prevent nearby sources from being promoted by semantic naming or geometry. This lane is low-information until an exact-center raw measurement becomes available.
findings.action: Deprioritize; preserve frozen coordinate and only retry exact-center raw imaging without recentering.

findings.observation: At the frozen LOVE-EDEM bisector seafloor point, the later direct-data audit resolved GEBCO 2026 TID=40 (satellite-gravity prediction) and found no curated GMRT or NCEI multibeam track/swath within the frozen 25 km buffer in the current catalogs. The crust-age model is about 96.1 Ma and the point is normal oceanic crust in the current model.
findings.why_topa_keeps_it: This closes the temptation to infer fine artificial morphology from a gravity-predicted global bathymetry surface.
findings.action: No fine morphology scoring unless a direct academic/industry seismic or sonar line is recovered at the exact frozen point.

next_pass.name: TOPA-TESLA-HUNT-004
tasks: Search post-2020 literature and expedition records for genuinely new hydrothermal fields inside approximately 20N-10S that were not public before 2020-03-25
Recover original 2022 Table S1 / Data Set S1 and freeze segment lookup before using any later vent labels
Build the 20-second airgun cadence into Tesla Sweep's machine-family control schema
Construct an off-axis seismicity mechanism matrix for the 70 km feature
Keep semantic/coordinate-only lanes below measured physical replication lanes

topa_conclusion: The hunt improved because TOPA rejected one of its own attractive validation ideas before scoring it. The genuinely useful discoveries in this pass are the correction itself, a new periodic anthropogenic control already embedded in the hydroacoustic corpus, and an open multisensor hydrothermal ground-truth dataset suitable for blinded physical-method testing.
